result.reason: The redline reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. It permits an unspecified minimum commitment in an Order Form and does not limit it to the current 12-month term or allow reduction on 30 days’ notice. The termination carve-outs are not a substitute for the required reduction right. The statement that unused commitment will be credited against amounts otherwise payable is ambiguous, is not a clear true-up mechanism, and could affect unrelated payment obligations. The added cross-references and broad credit remedy are unnecessary and poorly defined.
